## Summary

## Type of change

<!-- Check one. -->

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking)
- [ ] Breaking change
- [ ] Refactor / internal cleanup
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] Build / CI / tooling

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (if behavior changed)
- [ ] Bug fix: added a unit test that fails without the fix (red → green)
- [ ] `pnpm check` passes and the diff was reviewed locally before the push
- [ ] `@copilot` requested as reviewer (advisory; real bugs fixed in one commit)
- [ ] In-repo docs updated for any package / script / seam change (see `AGENTS.md` → Documentation)
- [ ] Generic code noted in `docs/promotion.md`
